name: Enclosure
notes: Sixteen farm/plantation gates and the agricultural decree remain on an unindexed Era IV root.

name: Intensive Agriculture
notes: TECH2H already distributes soil methods, sheep farming, chemical buildings and later prerequisites; the old node still owns them at runtime.

name: Manufacturies
notes: The broad vanilla factory gateway still runs beside the frozen specialized factory, textile, glass, paper and tooling branches.

name: Lathe
notes: TECH1A classified a strong merge, but TECH2H did not freeze the three production-method transfers individually.

name: Distillation
notes: Pot stills and sweeteners are distinct from later fractional/continuous separation; fractional_distillation currently and correctly requires distillation.

name: Crystal Glass
notes: Lead crystal and mechanically pressed glass are different processes; crystal_glass owns a unique crystal-glass production method.

name: Colonization
notes: Colonial laws, institution, expeditions and treaty responsibility are broader than cadastral surveying; TECH2H explicitly preserves the diplomatic chain.

name: Corporate Charters
notes: TECH1A classified a strong merge; thirteen company requirements and corporate-capacity modifiers still depend on the unindexed node.

name: Pharmaceuticals
notes: TECH2H assigns both modifiers, both health laws and the quinine bridge to active_principle_pharmacy, but the old node remains researchable.
